r.osc1pulse.init: Oscillator 1 pulse LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 1. Turn it up.

r.osc1sine.init: Oscillator 1 sine LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 2. Turn it up.

r.osc2.init: Both of Oscillator 2’s LEVEL knobs are at 0, so nothing leaves row 3. Turn up the pulse or the saw.

r.osc3tri.init: Oscillator 3 triangle LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 4. Turn it up.

r.osc3sh.init: Oscillator 3’s pulse LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 5. Turn it up, or switch row 5 to the S&H.
r.osc3sh.snh.select=\"snh\": The S&H LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 5. Turn it up.

r.noise.init: Noise LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 6. Turn it up.

r.in1.init: Input 1 LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 7. Turn it up.

r.ef.init: EF LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 8. Turn it either way.
r.ef.in1.ef=-5: Input 1 LEVEL is at 0, so the envelope follower hears nothing. Turn it up.
r.ef.in1.ef=-2.5: Input 1 LEVEL is at 0, so the envelope follower hears nothing. Turn it up.
r.ef.in1.ef=2.5: Input 1 LEVEL is at 0, so the envelope follower hears nothing. Turn it up.

r.in2.init: Input 2 LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 9. Turn it up.

r.vcf.init: Filter LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 10. Turn it up.

r.trap.init: The TRAPEZOID level is at 0, so nothing leaves row 11. Turn it up.

r.envsig.init: The trapezoid SIGNAL level is at 0, so nothing leaves row 12. Turn it up.

r.ring.init: Ring modulator LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 13. Turn it up.

r.fx.init: Effects LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 14. Turn it up.

r.joyy.init: The joystick’s ↕ LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 15. Turn it up.

r.joyx.init: The joystick’s ↔ LEVEL is at 0, so nothing leaves row 16. Turn it up.

c.vcf.lfo@init: The LFO is a control voltage, not a sound. Fed into the filter it gives clicks at most.
c.vcf.audio@init: The filter now takes oscillator 1. LPF darkens it, HPF thins it, RESONANCE makes it ring. The result is on row 10 at the filter LEVEL knob, so pin row 10 to an output (or to the Envelope Signal column first, to give it an envelope).
c.vcf.noise@init: The filter now takes the noise generator. LPF darkens it, HPF thins it, RESONANCE makes it ring. The result is on row 10 at the filter LEVEL knob, so pin row 10 to an output (or to the Envelope Signal column first, to give it an envelope).
c.vcf.fast@init: The filter now takes the fast LFO. LPF darkens it, HPF thins it, RESONANCE makes it ring. The result is on row 10 at the filter LEVEL knob, so pin row 10 to an output (or to the Envelope Signal column first, to give it an envelope).
